diagnosis: C4 permits a 4:00 p.m. pickup without requiring evidence that the earlier time was explicitly agreed. Thus a settlement can pass all checks while violating the stated acceptance condition.
evidence: C4 only checks decisions['pickup_time'] against the allowed time strings and does not inspect commitments for an explicit earlier-time agreement.
fix_instructions: Add a check requiring either the original Friday 6:00 p.m. offer or a commitment explicitly documenting that Cal agreed to the earlier Friday 4:00 p.m. pickup.
